title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-27

ai_review.summary: Great 1973 Friday‑night party turned sound‑check concert with a standout Bird Song, though the recording is uneven and could be clearer.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise the performance – calling it a great show that evolved from an unexpected two‑hour soundcheck – and highlight the soaring Bird Song as a high point. The audio quality is described as mixed: decent for a 1973 audience capture but noticeably better later in the set, leaving listeners wishing for a cleaner source overall.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance (high show rating) offset by uneven recording quality; weighted average yields ~4.4 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Early part of tape sounds modest, listeners wish for better fidelity; sound improves by the Bird Song segment and becomes close to spectacular.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A spontaneous Friday‑night party that turned into a two‑hour soundcheck concert, maintaining high energy throughout with an especially powerful second half.
